newsitem.title: USA: Polar to begin global cargo service.
newsitem.headline: Polar to begin global cargo service.

text.p: Polar Air Cargo plans to begin the only around-the-world all-cargo service next month, a company executive said Monday.
"It follows nicely the flow of trade," Kevin Montgomery, vice president, government and industry affairs, told Reuters.

The Long Beach, California-based all-cargo airline will fly weekly from New York to London to Amsterdam to Dubai to Delhi to Bangkok to Taipei to Khabarovsk, Russia, to Anchorage, Alaska, Montgomery said. The frequency could be increased depending on demand.
This is the first round-the-world cargo service in nearly a decade, Montgomery said. Polar secured the final foreign government approvals in January, Montgomery said.
